rules.description: Verifying Authorities must register on NSP by 30 September 2017 to be eligible for participation in the 2017-18 cycle.
rules.condition: The Verifying Authority registers on or before 30 September 2017.
rules.outcome: The authority becomes eligible to participate in the 2017-18 program.
rules.evidence_quote: Though, registration is a continuous process, the Verifying Authorities (State authority/District authority/Institute/School etc.) may register themselves on NSP by 30th September, 2017 to be eligible to participate in 2017-18.

rules.description: All States and Union Territories are responsible for sensitizing their Verifying Authorities to register on NSP by the stipulated deadline.
rules.condition: States/UTs have the duty to inform and encourage their Verifying Authorities about the registration deadline.
rules.outcome: They must ensure Verifying Authorities register by the stipulated date.
rules.evidence_quote: It will be the responsibility of all the States/UTs to sensitize their respective Verifying Authorities to register themselves on NSP by the stipulated date.

rules.description: Institutes and Schools are required to register on NSP as part of the Verifying Authority registration process.
rules.condition: An Institute or School seeks to participate as a Verifying Authority.
rules.outcome: It must complete registration on NSP.
rules.evidence_quote: This would include registration by the Institutes/Schools.
